title: English Calibration Erodes Lithuanian in Expert-Pruned Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.07654v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Expert pruning compresses Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models by removing the experts that a calibration set marks as unimportant. Studies of high-resource languages largely find that English calibration transfers well to other languages. We test this for Lithuanian: we pruned four MoE models with REAP, removing 25% or 50% of the experts with English, Lithuanian or mixed calibration, and evaluated both languages on reading comprehension, translation and language modelling. English calibration does not transfer to Lithuanian: at 25% pruning, English comprehension fell by a median of 1.7 points but Lithuanian by 21.4. The transfer is asymmetric. Lithuanian calibration removed most of the Lithuanian loss and never significantly hurt English comprehension, which was on average 2.5 points better than under English calibration; only English language modeling got slightly worse. tldr: 该研究发现英语校准在专家剪枝的MoE模型中无法迁移到立陶宛语——25%剪枝率下英语理解仅下降1.7分而立陶宛语下降21.4分，而立陶宛语校准却能同时保护两种语言的性能。
